claim_scope: The strict three-bandwidth sign pattern and disconnectedness of the positive-definite bandwidth set for the six-cycle graph metric, for every real exponent in [647/300, 653/300].
integrity: Proof is a discrete Fourier calculation plus exact rational Taylor interval certificates, independently reproducible from the embedded standalone checker. No independent verification or publication-priority certification is asserted.
limitations: No full transition-boundary classification, smallest-graph claim, larger-cycle extension, or application-specific statistical guarantee is established. Related but mathematically different disconnected S-divergence bandwidth sets predate this result; equivalent unindexed cycle calculations remain a risk.
title: Reentrant positive definiteness of geodesic exponential kernels on the six-cycle
